title: Feature request - settings for Bluetooth devices
symptom: The user requests a feature to split the selection of Bluetooth device entries (e.g., bluereader, limitter, bluecon, sweetreader) into separate settings, because current automatic detection can cause problems later, such as special settings only being applied after a successful connection and checks depending on connection status.
evidence_quote: I would like to discuss to split the selection of the bluetooth device entry for bluereader, limitter, bluecon, sweetreader and so on. At the.moment we detect the right device while connecting, which caused some problems later on.
